title: Ergonomic mesh office chair
summary: Breathable mesh chair with adjustable lumbar support, seat height, arm rests and tilt tension. Best for long desk sessions.

title: 8-in-1 USB-C hub
summary: Laptop expansion hub with HDMI, USB-A, USB-C power delivery, SD reader and Ethernet. Verify the laptop USB-C port supports video output.

title: Insulated stainless-steel water bottle
summary: Reusable bottle with a leak-resistant cap. Choose capacity based on daily use and check whether the lid is dishwasher safe.

title: Wireless productivity keyboard
summary: Full-size low-profile keyboard for multi-device productivity. Consider layout, backlighting needs and operating-system compatibility before buying.

title: Affiliate disclosure guidance
summary: Clearly disclose affiliate relationships close to the recommendation or link. Do not claim a price, stock level or discount unless it is current and verifiable.
